# T-2: Add schema repair retry

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Retry one schema-invalid parsed spec-review response through a schema-repair-only prompt and feed the repaired response through the same parser.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R3 performs at most one additional agent call for schema-invalid parsed responses after normalization.
- R4 keeps invalid repair responses as failures.
- R5 successful repair writes the existing artifact shape.

## Implementation Notes
Likely target: runSpecReview around callReviewAgent and parseSpecReviewFindings. The repair prompt must include the required schema and original raw response, not a request to re-review the spec.

## Test Strategy
Use test doubles or exported helpers to verify call count, repair prompt content, success path, and failure path without invoking a real provider.
